newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh tea prices rise on overseas demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh tea prices rise on overseas demand.

text.p: Bangladesh tea prices rose as local and foreign buyers were active at the weekly auction on Tuesday, brokers said.
Pakistan, Russia, Poland and Afghanistan lifted mainly good liquoring brokens and fannings.
More than 984,789 kg of teas were sold at the auction.
The average price was 44.33 taka, up 0.34 from the previous sale.
The next auction will be held on November 12 with an offer of 1.26 million kg.
